candidates.sentence: This bill will save lives and help stop the gun violence epidemic that has plagued our communities for far too long.
I will continue to advocate for defensive and humanitarian aid to Ukraine that is not tied to other offensive military aid that I cannot support.

We must all unite against extremist Republicans and white supremacists, including former President Donald Trump, who have spent their whole lifes targeting marginalized communities—promoting hate against Black, immigrant, Muslim, Latinx, women, people with disabilities and Jewish-Americans.
I meet regularly with Ukrainian-American community members in my district to discuss and engage on how the U.S. can support Ukraine in Russia’s war of aggression.
I believe in the essential right of Ukraine to defend itself in this war, and in the moral obligation of the United States to support that defense.
I support aid for Ukraine, but I cannot vote for a package that would increase and prolong the suffering of civilians in Gaza.
Strengthen and protect critical Social Security benefits
Repeal the Republican’s 2017 tax scheme that cut taxes for the nation’s highest earners while driving down revenue for important federal programs that support everyday Americans
Repeal the billions of dollars in tax breaks provided to fossil fuel companies
We must guarantee access to pre-kindergarten, childcare, and invest in debt-free college.
We must eliminate the need to borrow for college, and invest in debt-free college to ensure that everyone, regardless of their income or zip code, has access to a public education.
End the $757 billion that fossil fuel corporations receive in tax subsidies each year
Protect access to gender-affirming medical care
Oppose the privatization of the Veterans Affairs healthcare system and expand funding for physical and mental healthcare for veterans
With wars in Ukraine, Yemen, Sudan, and the Middle East, the U.S. must use our power – and purse – to advance the values we claim to hold.
Support Ukraine in the defense of their homeland against Russian aggression
